name: A Plus Biotechnology Co Ltd
summary: A Plus Biotechnology Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, manufacture, and sales of orthopedic medical equipment. Its products include orthopediatrics pedinail systems, anatomical fixes, dynamic compression locking plates, cable fixation systems, and trochanter hip screws. The company was founded on September 4, 2009 and is headquartered in New Taipei, Taiwan.
